ThingDef.label: Prima Hyperseed: Thistle Turret
ThingDef.description:
A masterfully crafted seed that will quickly grow into a Prima Thistle Turret within a day. Knowledge on how to make hyperseeds is highly guarded, and a secret only the most devoted possess. Not only do these bypass wait times and research requirements, but they also enable deployment of turrets offensively; a tactic that can be frighteningly effective. 
Hyperseeds are meant to be used shortly after acquisition, and will expire rather quickly. Be sure to not hang onto them for too long! 

Key notes: Significantly lowered growth time when compared to normal method (from ~6 full days to ~1) No research or tech level requirement Quick growth time allows offensive or rapid response use
